meta.themes: Agent Platforms, Enterprise Deployment, AI Security, Infrastructure Pressure

news.title: OpenAI launched a $4B Deployment Company for enterprise AI rollouts
news.summary: OpenAI launched the OpenAI Deployment Company, agreed to acquire Tomoro, and lined up 19 investment and consulting partners to embed forward deployed engineers into enterprise AI projects.

news.title: Anthropic launched Claude for Small Business with agentic workflows
news.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude for Small Business, packaging connectors and 15 ready-to-run workflows for tools such as QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, DocuSign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365.

news.title: GitHub Copilot app entered technical preview for agentic development
news.summary: GitHub introduced a native Copilot desktop app preview that starts agent sessions from issues, pull requests, prompts, and previous sessions, then carries work through validation and PR review.

news.title: GitHub exposed Copilot cloud agent task starts through a REST API
news.summary: GitHub added a public-preview Agent tasks REST API so Copilot Business and Enterprise teams can programmatically launch cloud agent work for refactors, repository setup, and release prep.

news.title: AWS highlighted AgentCore payments and a managed MCP server
news.summary: AWS detailed Bedrock AgentCore payments with Coinbase and Stripe, Agent Toolkit for AWS, the GA AWS MCP Server, and WorkSpaces for AI agents as part of its May 11 roundup.

news.title: Meta launched Incognito Chat for private AI conversations
news.summary: Meta introduced Incognito Chat with Meta AI on WhatsApp and the Meta AI app, using Private Processing so conversations are temporary and inaccessible even to Meta.

news.title: OpenAI offered EU access to GPT-5.5-Cyber for oversight and defense
news.summary: CNBC reported that OpenAI would grant EU authorities and trusted European partners access to GPT-5.5-Cyber while talks with Anthropic over Mythos access remained behind.

news.title: OpenAI disclosed impact from the TanStack npm supply chain attack
news.summary: OpenAI said two employee devices were affected by the Mini Shai-Hulud TanStack npm compromise and that it rotated credentials and signing certificates while finding no customer data exposure.

news.title: Google stopped a zero-day exploit it says showed signs of AI assistance
news.summary: The Verge reported that Google Threat Intelligence Group disrupted a planned mass exploitation campaign after finding evidence that exploit code may have been developed with AI help.

news.title: ChatGPT added Plaid-powered personal finance account connections
news.summary: OpenAI launched a ChatGPT personal finance preview for U.S. Pro users, letting them connect accounts through Plaid for personalized spending, portfolio, and planning insights.

news.title: xAI's data center turbine buildout intensified AI power scrutiny
news.summary: TechCrunch reported that xAI was operating nearly 50 gas turbines at its Mississippi data center, underscoring how frontier AI infrastructure is colliding with permitting and power constraints.

news.title: Vapi raised $50M as enterprise voice-agent adoption accelerated
news.summary: The Next Web reported that voice-agent platform Vapi raised a $50 million Series B at a $500 million valuation after passing one billion calls and landing major enterprise deployments.
